<thought>To determine the number of carbonyl groups, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample and count how many distinct carbon signals appear in the typical carbonyl chemical shift region (≈180–210 ppm). Each carbonyl carbon gives one signal, so this count equals the number of carbonyl groups.</thought>
